pc_changelog:
v8.0.0 — Auto-Hide Taskbar Support & Notes Improvements

• New: Smart floating mode when taskbar auto-hide is enabled — widget appears in the bottom corner.
• Fixed: Widget mode transition (floating ↔ embedded) now works reliably when toggling auto-hide.
• Fixed: Full cache invalidation during mode transitions prevents ghost positioning bugs.
• Improved: Removed scroll-to-resize on note images — cleaner interaction.
